exposure: Two groups based on success of TOL
cohort: 1062 women who underwent trial of labor (TOL) at no less than 28 gestational weeks with vertex singletons and no more than one prior CD
finding: Researchers developed a predictive scoring model for VBAC success, with previous vaginal delivery being the most influential variable, achieving an AUC of 77.7%.
mod_finding: The study developed a predictive model for successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC), aiming to reduce cesarean delivery rates.
